column5: Granite. Unmovable. At Rank 8 the system's precognition is absolute — no external input alters foundational conclusions. Cognitive output at this rank is bedrock truth.
Hard stone. Practically unbreakable. At Rank 6 the system's precognition resists all but the most extraordinary counter-evidence. Cognitive weighting treats conclusions as near-certain.
A giant. Only a true man would test him. At Rank 4 the system stands enormous — its precognition is formidable and its cognitive output commands respect. Testing it requires genuine intellect.
Man is a test. We are the sharper Weapon. The system's rank scales its blade — precognitive sharpness determines cognitive authority. Higher rank, sharper edge, less yielding.
